text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging #oncall — P99 latency surge and increased 5xx rates after rollout to prod (deploy id 2026.03.15-478). Symptoms: 502/504 gateway errors, request timeouts, p95/p99 blowup. Please ack and triage. Root TS: 6133337777

emma-sre: acked. I'm oncall. seeing alerts in console, pulling traces now.

matt-observ: timeline: deploy completed at 6133337000. metrics show p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~1.6s and p99 to ~4.8s within 2m post-deploy. 5xx rate went from 0.07% -> 3.4%. error types = gateway timeout (504) + upstream 502 from runtime. Correlation: ingress -> routing->model-runtime pool. Dashboard: https://console/redwood/observ/trace/6133337xxx

jake-deploy: rollback candidate ready: previous image tag "runner:2026.03.14-992". no DB schema changes. Rolling canary target was 10% traffic.

emma-sre: do we have canary-level impact only or region-wide? matt?

matt-observ: initial canary nodes show degradation, then cascade to more nodes because autoscaler triggered spin-up causing cold-start tail on new nodes (KV warm is not fully primed). traces show repeated retries building up queuing.

carol-support: seeing customer-facing errors reported in status page. ~4200 requests failing in the last 10m, mostly API path /v1/generate. Customer impact: some enterprise customers on Dedicated unaffected — looks like routing favored hosted pool where deploy ran.

ryan-product: we should notify affected customers. Can we confirm scope quickly (org ids)? carol?

carol-support: quick count: ~18 orgs with >1% error rate, 3 orgs >5% error. I'll draft a short status note once we stabilise.

emma-sre: two immediate mitigations: 1) revert the deploy (fast) 2) if rollback takes >5m, divert traffic off hosted pool to previous stable fleet (route-shift). Jake, start rollback now and flag if fail.

jake-deploy: executing rollback. command:
```
rb rollback --service=runner --to=runner:2026.03.14-992 --reason="postdeploy p99 regression"
```

deployer-bot: rollback job queued (job id rb-6133337780). Starting rollback on hosted pool nodes.

infra-runner: starting graceful drain of new nodes, reattach traffic to previous replica set. If drain hits 30s soft limit we'll force-kill to speed recovery.

matt-observ: telemetry: after rollback start, p95 dropped slightly in first 30s but still elevated. queue length decreasing on ingress but still some tail latency. replays show some stuck requests due to KV cache misses — those will resolve as nodes warm.

emma-sre: can we also reduce max concurrency on the ingress to avoid queuing and retries? that buys time while nodes warm.

infra-runner: lowering max_concurrency for hosted ingress from 100 -> 40 now.

jake-deploy: rollback completed on 90% of hosts. deployer-bot confirms previous image active: runner:2026.03.14-992.

deployer-bot: rollback completed (rb-6133337780). time=6133337788

matt-observ: metrics update: p95 back to ~180ms, p99 trending down to ~700ms, 5xx rate dropping toward baseline. Still seeing a small tail from long-running requests that will time out.

carol-support: I'm posting interim status: "We experienced elevated errors and timeouts after a recent deploy impacting hosted API calls to /v1/generate. We've rolled back the deploy and are monitoring. Some customers saw errors — follow-up details to come." tagging affected org owners.

ryan-product: good. prepare a short postmortem draft with timelines and rollback rationale. include mitigations: stronger canary gating, KV warm strategy, autoscaler cooldown tuning, and ingress backpressure.

emma-sre: immediate follow-ups: 1) verify no more error spikes for 30m 2) run synthetic smoke across all regions 3) add guardrail to prevent autoscaler from scaling beyond N nodes within M minutes in canary windows

nora-custsuccess: reached out to top 3 impacted customers with contextual note. requesting any customer RPC logs if they want deeper triage.

sre-lead: summary for handoff: rollback successful, p95/p99 improved but watch 30m window. Action items assigned:
- matt-observ: gather full traces and heatmap (ETA 45m)
- jake-deploy: add pre-rollback checklist and automated canary rollback threshold (ETA 2d)
- infra-runner: implement ingress concurrency backpressure as a short-term knob (ETA 1d) and autoscaler cooldown tuning (ETA 3d)
- product/ryan: coordinate customer comms & internal postmortem (ETA 24h)

emma-sre: acknowledging handoff. leaving a short runbook note in /runbooks/postdeploy-latency.md: include how to run rollback command, traffic shift steps, and sample grep for 504 patterns.

matt-observ: pasting quick grep snippet for triage:
```
jq -r '.events[] | select(.status|test("504|502")) | .trace_id' traces.json | xargs -L1 curl https://console/redwood/trace/
```

carol-support: will keep status page updated. will escalate to Legal/CS if any contractual SLA thresholds crossed.

sre-lead: closing the immediate incident thread — will reopen if new signs appear. final note: primary root cause preliminary = interaction between new runtime changes and autoscaler behavior causing cold-start/queue amplification; KV/priming strategy missed during canary. full RCA to follow.

emma-sre: :thumbsup: thanks team. oncall clear in 30m unless alerting returns.
